notes: S1 disabled (engine=strategy2.py). 2026-08-14 session: THE SIZING BUG. Nine of ten closed S2 trades sized within 13% of the 1% risk budget; FIL (2026-08-12 22:01) sized at 4.01x and lost $33.29 against a $6.97 budget. That single trade is $25 of the account's entire $29.68 realised loss (84%). Root cause: strategy2.signal validates MIN_SL_PCT=0.4% against the SIGNAL price, but open_trade sizes as 1/(stop distance) off a freshly-polled EXECUTION price. FIL's stop was 1.168% away at signal and ~0.121% away at execution (reconstructed from the recorded size to within 0.06%), so size went 2151 -> 8642 units. FIXED in executor.py: re-validate the stop against MIN_SL_PCT at execution price and ABORT (never resize up). Backtested against all 10 closed trades - the other 9 sit at 0.725-1.578% stop distance, so none would have been blocked. ALSO FIXED tracker.py: lost-update race on state.json. The update loop load_state()'d before a network round-trip and save_state()'d the whole stale snapshot after, erasing any position register_position() added in between. That is why OP was in journal.json but missing from state.json on 08-13 with no exception logged; a position dropped from `tracked` gets no ratchet management at all. State is now loaded AFTER the round-trip. ALSO FIXED analyze.py: the confluence table keyed on reason.split(' ')[0], so '4.2 ATR from mean' became a factor named '4.2'; replaced with entry condition BANDS. Added DIRECTION SPLIT and EXIT MECHANISM sections. The 'CURRENT STRATEGY CONFIG' block printed this file's dead S1 values under a live-sounding heading; it now prints strategy2's real constants and labels these as dead. Signal->trade join was date-only, now nearest-timestamp. DATA (n=11): WR 36.4%, sumR -1.93, meanR -0.175R. Exit mechanism: 7 original-stop at meanR -1.034, 4 ratcheted-stop at meanR +1.329. Breakeven needs 43.8% WR; we are at 36.4% with sigma 14.5pp at n=11, i.e. 0.5 sigma from breakeven - not distinguishable. Direction: 11 LONG, 0 SHORT, against a measured structural baseline of 72/28 (MAX_ADX kills 92.1% of longs but 96.7% of shorts). No parameter changes: every S2 constant is owner-locked.
